item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Jakeob Aldon glared at Felix Cori, and Felix smugged at her. Smugged is now a word, it is the past-tense of smug, which is also now a verb. It means "to be in a state of deserving a punch in your stupid, smug face."

Clevered is a verb as well. It means "to be too taken with one's cuteness; to be obnoxious while thinking oneself clever." It seems to be endemic to longer series on the site, and I see that this is no exception.

Otherwise, it's mostly just Aldon does a thing and also there is a ferret. Moves the action forward, but otherwise doesn't do much for me. But seriously, that opening paragraph is heinous and pushed a no-to-up-vote straight into down boat territory. -1

item.title: Author Notes
item.content:encoded:
A big thanks to djkaktus, Jacob Conwell, and Kate McTiriss for looking this over. Sorry this took so long.

Only skip I can immediately think of referencing is SCP-845, which is what Everett is. Everett is now a recurring character, and as such the series is now titled Aldon and Finnegan Everett the Alphabet.
